description: A release has to have been public for 14 days before Renovate will propose it. With patch and minor updates automerging unattended, this is the window in which a compromised or immediately-yanked publish gets found by someone else before it can land here on its own.

Security fixes are not delayed by this: Renovate's vulnerabilityAlerts defaults are minimumReleaseAge null, an empty schedule and prCreation immediate, so a CVE fix is raised straight away regardless of the wait below.

packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates merge themselves. The Unit tests & build check is required on main, so nothing lands without the suite passing. Majors are left alone deliberately.

Database migration tooling and the driver it runs through stay manual. A green suite does not prove a migration applies cleanly to production data, and a bad migration is not undone by reverting the commit.
